newsitem.title: USA: American Oilfield gets Hard Suits CEO offer.
newsitem.headline: American Oilfield gets Hard Suits CEO offer.

text.p: AOD Acquisition Corp, a subsidiary of American Oilfield Divers Inc, said on Tuesday that Hard Suits Inc Chief Executive Rene Nuytten has agreed to tender at least 1.5 million Hard Suits shares.
The agreement follows AOD's offer to acquire all of Hard Suits shares for C$1.65 per share.
In connection with Nuytten's agreement, AOD said it has extended its offer for Hard Suits shares to November 8.
AOD said in light of these events, the Hard Suits board has recommended acceptance for the AOD offer.
Nuytten is expected to resign as a Hard Suits director after tendering his shares, the company added.
